Whereas Veterans Day observed annually on November 11th in the United States is a time to honor and recognize the selfless service and sacrifices of all those past and present who served with the U.S. Armed Forces to defend the freedoms and rights that are so important to our nation's democracy. And whereas Veterans Day, formerly known as Armistice Day, is the anniversary of the signing of the Armistice by the Allies and Germans in 1918 ending World War I. Armistice Day officially received its name in the United States in 1926 and became an official national holiday in 1938 through congressional resolutions.

In 1954, President Eisenhower signed a congressional bill that changed the holiday's name to Veterans Day. And whereas Americans owe a great debt to the soldiers, sailors, airmen, and marines who serve and defend our freedom in war and peace, and their families and communities that support them.

And whereas Fairfax County Public Schools has strong ties to our veterans, as our division proudly employs many veterans who now serve as teachers, administrators, and support staff in our schools and division departments.
